svg.title: 04 research workflow
svg.desc: Six-stage workflow separating current cached implementation from future teacher extraction, student training and confirmation.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(96%,97%,98%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: A staged workflow keeps development and confirmation distinct
Use the available cache first; acquire new teacher evidence only for the question that needs it.

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Trace notebooks; verify arithmetic; test known symmetry and order signals.

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Fix support/current-posture references, grids, controls and source partitions.

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Train-only transforms; inner selection; outer predictions; paired uncertainty.

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: New physical-time windows and mirrored teacher encoding; causal input audits.

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Ordinary S-JEPA, full targets, selected targets and exact no-transfer option.

polygon.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Freeze one method and endpoint; include subject-separated evidence.
Stages 1-3 can use current cached arrays. Later stages need additional empirical evidence.
